label: SIMULATED TRAFFIC — Playwright persona bots, not humans. Demonstration of the pipeline; outcomes follow the persona model, not evidence about real users. Lift is a function of the assumed share of keyboard, screen-reader and low-vision users.
frictionDisclosure: 60% of treatment conversions are dropped by construction (bots click through the modal; the friction is an injected drop-off). With the assumed mix, treatment cannot beat control, expected −50%. The decision isn't hard-coded, but the loss is.
personaMixNote: Assumed mix is a modelling choice (mouse 70%, keyboard 10%, screen-reader 10%, low-vision 10%), not measured traffic. realisedMix is this run's actual draws. Win threshold is 95%.
personasNote: local visit log, n=400; Flagsmith counted n=400
outcome: Flagsmith completed the experiment and pulled to control.
honesty: Barrier flags are wired on the site; this run used the bundled pricing_a11y native experiment. Sequential per-barrier experiments are the attribution path.

headline.copy: Flagsmith lift (SIMULATED traffic, assumed mix 70/10/10/10): -50.2%, P(win) <0.1%, 95% CI −61.6% to −38.7%, pulled to control
